newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks fall; investors ring up cash register.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks fall; investors ring up cash register.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks ended with double-digit losses Monday as investors rang up the cash register and took profits after the market's scorching rally.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average closed 37.32 points lower at 7,858.49 after soaring early in the session above the 7,900-level. Last week, the blue-chip index jumped more than 200 points.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a small margin on active volume of 522 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
